requirements.text: A communication feature for patients to reach out to staff easily, ensuring they feel supported.
Appointment management capabilities (booking, canceling, rescheduling) that are thoughtfully implemented to maintain personal contact.
Online submission of repeat prescription requests, with necessary clinician review to prevent errors.
Strong security measures, including encryption, to protect patient data and ensure compliance with guidelines.
Features designed to preserve the personal touch in patient interactions, even with the introduction of the online system.
